info.name: TicketingSystem — acceptance S1–S7
info.description: One folder per delivered story, run top to bottom. Before a Collection Runner pass: stack up, `tools/seed.sh`, `tools/tunnels.sh up`, and `make demo-outbox DEDUPE_KEY=accept` twice. Select the `TicketingSystem local` environment. Only the documented dev-only seed credentials appear in the environment; tokens are fetched at run time.

item.name: S5 — Group changes and deprovisioning take effect within 10 minutes
item.description: TICK-47. An administrator changes Alice in Keycloak (admin API, as the console would); the same, still-valid token sees the change after the next `nava-groupsync` cycle. The polling requests repeat in the Collection Runner until the change shows (at most 11 min).
